title: chore(hetzner-bootstrap): drop unattended-upgrades once dev-env-setup 1.14.updates lands
description:
## .what

drop `unattended-upgrades` from the hetzner grove bootstrap: dev-env-setup's `1.14.updates` bundle now owns it on every cloud grove.

## .why

two writers on one artifact drift. the bundle installs the package, writes `/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/52grove-unattended-upgrades`, and enables `apt-daily-upgrade.timer`, then verifies all three on each provision. its drop-in also keeps a changed dpkg conffile (`--force-confdef`, `--force-confold`), so an unattended upgrade never reverts a policy a bundle fenced into `/etc` — measured 2026-11-15 on hetzner for `/etc/ImageMagick-6/policy.xml`. a bootstrap copy of the same config would not carry that, and whichever ran last would win.

## .the shape of the fix

remove the `unattended-upgrades` install and config from the bootstrap. the box gets it on the ground seat's first `grove.provision` apply (`rhx git.grove.provision boot <grove>`, step 2).

## .when

once dev-env-setup's hetzner platform PR (`beav/feat-grove-provision-hetzner-platform`) lands on main. until then, keep it — the bundle is a no-op over an equal config.
